milestone: Static periodic D3Q27 coarse/fine box with genuine spatial interfaces and 2:1 subcycling
model: Unforced, no SGS, low-Mach cumulant D3Q27, float64, pre-collision states; same physical shear and bulk viscosities on both levels
algorithm: Coarse prediction over one full step; coarse old/predicted pre-collision moments supply fine donors at t and t+dt_c/2
Two fine collision/stream steps; physical fine cells own the covered region; coarse covered cells are virtual and excluded from integrals
Exact Cartesian-face decomposition of D3Q27 streaming, symmetrized over all coordinate orders
Integrated actual fine flux over four child faces and two substeps replaces coarse interface flux by local reflux into adjacent coarse cells
Reflux changes equilibrium for the required density/momentum increment, preserving the pre-existing non-equilibrium PDF part; no global density or momentum adjustment
Volume restriction into virtual coarse cells only after synchronized completion
geometry: One static rectangular fine box aligned with coarse faces. Fully periodic enclosing domain. A box may span a whole periodic axis; all other box boundaries must be interior.

criteria_fixed_before_execution.subcycling: Exactly two fine steps per accepted coarse step, with integer clocks and distinct t/t+dt_c/2 donor states
criteria_fixed_before_execution.local_reflux: Changes restricted to the coarse cells sharing a Cartesian face with the fine box; no correction applied to all-domain averages

oblique_shear_wave.resolution_study: Save all three errors and differences. Finest error must be smaller than coarsest; do not claim GCI or order without asymptotic evidence.

advected_3d_gaussian_vortex.reference: Analytic periodic linear advection-diffusion of a Gaussian vector potential; exact cell averages. Small but finite-amplitude nonlinear/compressible effects are not claimed to vanish.

acoustic_packet.reference: Uniform coarse and fine D3Q27 calculations of the same 1D periodic acoustic initial state; transverse invariance permits symmetry reduction of the references. This is verification of our own numerics, not comparison with another CFD product.

criteria_fixed_before_execution.negative_control: A separately labelled run with reflux disabled must violate the declared mass or momentum tolerance; its failure is expected and must not be hidden.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.offline: Installed research wheel, unchanged pinned local dependencies, fresh JIT caches and blocked Python socket/DNS calls.
criteria_fixed_before_execution.memory: Estimate cell/PDF/moment/temporary memory before allocation and enforce a stated limit; distinguish estimate from measured process peak.
